weather_outlook: Mvua haitarajiwi kwa wiki mbili zijazo; jua na upepo mkali zitaendelea.
weather_outlook_en: No rainfall expected over the next 14 days; strong winds and high daytime temperatures will persist.
pasture_status: Malisho yameanza kukauka upande wa kusini mwa Laisamis.
pasture_status_en: Pasture conditions have deteriorated across southern Laisamis.
critical_water_point_dry_en: Kargi Pan is confirmed completely dry.
safe_water_point_available: Kisima cha Laisamis mjini bado kina maji safi na ya kuaminika.
safe_water_point_available_en: Laisamis Town borehole remains operational with reliable water yield.
market_advice: Bei ya mbuzi inashuka kidogo; ni wakati mzuri wa kupunguza mifugo dhaifu sokoni.
market_advice_en: Goat prices are trending downwards; herders are advised to sell off weaker stock before body condition drops further.
veterinary_action: Chanja mifugo dhidi ya magonjwa ya mapafu (CCPP) kabla ya kuhama.
veterinary_action_en: Vaccinate small stock against Contagious Caprine Pleuropneumonia (CCPP) prior to moving northward.
